name: Seventh Sense
summary: Seventh Sense optimizes email send times for each recipient using AI, boosting open and engagement rates. It integrates with popular email platforms for smarter campaigns.
description:
Seventh Sense optimizes email send times for each recipient using AI, boosting open and engagement rates. It integrates with popular email platforms for smarter campaigns.

AI email orchestration and performance management for HubSpot and Marketo: per-person send-time optimization, deliverability monitoring and audience recycling.

Personalizes delivery time for every recipient. Integrates with HubSpot and Marketo. Engagement analytics and reporting. AI-based audience segmentation.
